note: Village of Sugarcreek municipal grove; open grassy sites, hosts RV rallies. --Claude
summary: $25, 15-amp, May-Sept, no dump/showers, non-flush toilets all confirmed on the village page; reservable by phone; ordinary nightly camping stated, rally character from campers.
flags: LOCAL: the page describes ordinary camping for the public ('a beautiful location to camp', $25 per night, reservations by phone), not rally-only. Presence: village page live, 330-852-4112. Campers' view: 10/2025 Airstream rally guest (rating 8) 'Basically for large gatherings ... I would not suggest this for one offs since only electricity is provided'; 9/2024 (rating 6, $25) 'Many 30 amp power poles but campsite directions say only 15 amp service no a/c unless with generator. No water except behind clubhouse. Wide spacing between campsites. All grass'; 9/2024 (rating 8, $50, likely a rally rate) 'Great municipal park - super rally location'.

SITE COUNT and rig length: neither stated. Imagery shows open grass under scattered trees; 23 ft isn't in question. Inclusion is thin on one point: the page names no number of sites and 15 amps won't run EKKO's A/C without a generator.
Pin fine: at the grove's entrance road off the park drive, grove and pavilion just W. Stored not waterfront stands (small golf pond ~330 m W).
